title: RichTextLabel: Crash occurred while parsing the [p tab_stops=] tag
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee], master [e295eba0eb4767fd45ea8534765307d8e9b1c328]
- Not reproducible in: v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (e295eba0e) - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

When `bbcode_enabled` is enabled in `RichTextLabel`, it crashes while parsing `[p tab_stops=]`. For example, adding `tab_stops=32` to an existing `[p]` tag will cause a crash when typing `=`.

The following error message will be output:

```bash
ERROR: Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds (size() = 0).
   at: set (./core/templates/cowdata.h:178)
ERROR: FATAL: Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds (size() = 0).
   at: get (./core/templates/cowdata.h:193)
```

1. Open the following MRP and edit it.
2. Editor crash.
3. Run directly in the terminal, crash.
